content: Ezequiel-nodedi, galemaloed-e-wilub gued
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, dulemar-uayasulidamalad-abargi be gudiid. Ibya nikamalanad, degite, aku atakmalad. Uaya nikamalanad, degite, aku dule-itomalad. Ar uayasulidamaladid.

”Dule-machi, degisoggu, we-yargi-noega be-mormar be guagwar-dake. Neg-ibgine, dulemar-wagab be-neggi be nodoed. Ar igi dule yamo-yogasaar-ononnolenaidyobi be nodoed. Abakalegi, deyob be-dakmaloedba, we-dulemar-uayasulidamalad magar ibmar itoarmalale.
Neg-ibgine, dulemar-wagab be-ibmar be onogoed, geb sedogidba dulemar-wagab be naoed. Ar igi dule yargi yamo-yogasaar-ononnolenaidyobi, be nodoed.
Deginbali, bela-dulemar be-dakbukwad-wagab, galu-akwagi-sobaledgi be yaa ollomakoed. Geb a-yaa-olloledbali, be-mor-dukwa-annika be nodoed.
Neg-mutikgusale, be-mor-dukwa yarganba-nai dulemar bela be-dakbukwadgi, be nodoed. Mer yar-suid-dakega, wagar emurkwaa be imakoed, ar ade, Israel-dulemarga yoedse-ibmar-guoed e-wilubga be gued.”

Ar igi anga ibmar-soglesa, deyobi, an ibmar-imaksad. Neg-ibgine, an-mor-dukwa an onosad, ar igi dule yargi-yamo-yogasaar-ononnolenaidyobi, an nodoed. Sedogudgua, galugine an yaa ollomaksad. Geb mutikgudgua, bela dulemar-wagab an-mor-dukwa yarganba-nai an noded.
Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, napira an bega soged, Israel-dulemar-uayasulidamalad bese egisdamaloed: ‘¿Ibu be imaknaiye?’
”Ega be weyob odalogo: ‘Bab-Dummad-Jehová weyob sogye: We-ibmar-oyolenaidi, wedi Israel-dulemar Jerusalénʼgi-bukwamaladgi, degi, e-rey-maidgi, yoedse-ibmar-guoedi oyolenaiye.’
Israel-dulemarga be soge: ‘Ani an bemarga yoedse-ibmar-guoed-e-wilubga guye. ” ’An igi ibmar-imaksa, deyobi, bemar imaklemarmogoed, ar ade, bemar we-yargine gales ebipiledmaloed.’
”E-reyga-maid na yarganba mor-dukwa nasiksa imakoed, geb galu-akwagi-sobaledgi yaa-ollomakmaloedgi mutikidba nodoed. Mer yar-suid-dakega na wagar emurkwaa imakoed.
Reygi an-saki an mioed, geb agi an gaoed. Deyobi, Babiloniaʼse Caldea-dulemar-yarse an sedoed. Bar we-yar dakosulid, ar Babiloniaʼgi burgoed.
Bela e-walik-dulemar-gudimalad, e-bendakdimalad, deginbali, e-sordamar-bila-onomalad, we-napneg-ugakaase an bela oaisakioed. An wemar es-suidgi baleginnoed.
”Ar we-napneggi yar-baid-baid-ugakaase an oaisakisale, geb agi wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.

Unnila dulemar bila-onolegedgi ichee wakinmaloed. Degine, ukudmaad-mesedgi, bonigan-dummagangi ichee san-onogega an imakbaloed. Adi, bia dulemar-yar-baid-baidgi-bukwamaladse modapile, e-ibmar-imadaklemalad-imaksamalad sogmalagar. Geb degidbali, wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.”
Bab-Jehová anga sogded:
“Dule-machi, dobed-abalagine be mas gunne, surbinsa-itogedgi, wile-itogedgi be gobed gobe.

Dulemar-we-yarginmalad be owisoge, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob Israel-dulemargi, degi, Jerusalénʼginmaladgi, sogye: ‘Dobed-abalagi mas gunmaloye, surbinsa-itogedgi gobed gobmaloye. Sabsur dulemar-imakmalad-ulale, e-yargi ibmar-nikad bela berguoye.
Bela neggweburmar berguoye, e-yala napabi-nai guoye. Geb degine, bemar wisguoye, ani an Bab-Jehová guye.’ ”
Bab-Jehová anga sogdebalid:
“Dule-machi, ¿Israel-dulemar ibi obarmala? Ar sogdimalad: ‘Ibagan namaid, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-negburgan-daksad gwen gusurye.’

Degisoggu, we-dulemarga be sogo, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye: ‘We-deyob-sogleged mer bar sogmalaga an imakoye, Israel-yargine gannar-gannar bar sogosurmalad.’ Deginbali, ega be sogbalo: ‘Ibagan daniye, negburgan-daklesad-sanar-gued-ibagan, daniye.
Ar ade, Israel-dulemar-abargi negburgan-emar-yardaked-dakleged bar daklegosulid. Deginbali, ibmar-yoedse-guoed-sogleged-gakansaaled bar itolegosurbalid.

Ar ade, ani, Bab-Jehová, sunmakoed, an-ibmar-soged emisgwa guoed. Dulemar-uayasulidamalad, amba bemar-dula-gudiidgine, an-ibmar-sogsad an imakoed. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged.’ ”
Bab-Jehová anga sogdebalid:
“Dule-machi, Israel-dulemar sogdimalad: ‘Be-negburgan-daksad, wedi yoedse ibmar-gumalagarye, deginbali, be-ibmar-yoedse-guoed-sogdiid, wedi ibagan-yoedse danimaloedgarye.’
”Degisoggu, we-dulemarga be sogo, Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye: ‘An-ibmar-soged emisgwa guoye, an-ibmar-sogsad an imakoye. Ani an Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye.’ ”
